input.summary: Remove the $110 million floor on the Elected Total Amount so PB has no minimum funding commitment.
input.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the $110 million floor on the Elected Total Amount so we have no minimum commitment and can elect only the funding we actually need; Section 6.2 already scales the Approval Payments to the Development Costs actually funded. If SFJ needs a floor, we could look at one limited to the current 12-month period and reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up.

ops.oldText: which shall be no less than $110 million and no more than $120 million.
ops.newText: which shall be no more than $120 million, with no minimum amount.
